locations.note: The Lone Wanderer leaves Vault 101 to search the ruins of Washington for their father, James, and the water purifier he was building.
Project Purity's site: the Enclave under Colonel Autumn attacks it, and the Lone Wanderer's group escapes through an underground sewer tunnel.
The former Pentagon is the Citadel, where the group recruits the Brotherhood of Steel.
Captured after taking the G.E.C.K. from Vault 87, the Lone Wanderer is brought to the Enclave's base and meets President Eden, an artificial intelligence.
